title: gomphia spectabilis

It is a type of flowering plant native to tropical Africa, known for its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of Gomphia spectabilis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and tannins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as pain relief and wound healing.
